name: Adept Nursing & Rehab of Central City
priceNote: Nebraska average for a nursing home (semi-private to private room). This facility does not publish its price.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Staff lacked required skills
inspections.detail: Ensure that nurses and nurse aides have the appropriate competencies to care for every resident in a way that maximizes each resident's well being.

inspections.title: Honor the resident's right to request, refuse, and/or discontinue treatment, to participate in or refuse to participate in experimental research, and to formulate an advance directive
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to request, refuse, and/or discontinue treatment, to participate in or refuse to participate in experimental research, and to formulate an advance directive.

inspections.title: Medicare/Medicaid coverage notice not given
inspections.detail: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

inspections.title: Transfer / bed-hold notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

inspections.title: Incontinence or catheter care problems
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.

inspections.title: Dialysis care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe, appropriate dialysis care/services for a resident who requires such services.

inspections.title: Food not served at a safe or appetizing temperature
inspections.detail: Ensure food and drink is palatable, attractive, and at a safe and appetizing temperature.

inspections.title: Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food that accommodates resident allergies, intolerances, and preferences, as well as appealing options
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food that accommodates resident allergies, intolerances, and preferences, as well as appealing options.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Resident dignity not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

inspections.title: Improper transfer or discharge
inspections.detail: Not transfer or discharge a resident without an adequate reason; and must provide documentation and convey specific information  when a resident is transferred or discharged.

inspections.title: PASARR screening for Mental disorders or Intellectual Disabilities
inspections.detail: PASARR screening for Mental disorders or Intellectual Disabilities

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Breathing / oxygen care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.

inspections.title: Medical records incomplete or not protected
inspections.detail: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.

quality.label: Needing more help with daily activities

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: For-profit nursing home in Central City with 63 certified beds, part of Avid Healthcare Group. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab.

Price: CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Nebraska averages
